dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Totals since launch. Personal data never appears here.
dashboard.label: Group

signIn.title: Admin sign-in
signIn.mfaIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for HEACH Admin.
signIn.enrolIntro: Two-step sign-in is required. Add this key to an authenticator app (manual entry, time based), then enter the code it shows. The key is shown only now.

errors.invalid_credentials: Email or password is not right, or the account is locked. Try again later or ask a super admin.
errors.mfa_incorrect: That code is not right. Wait for the next code and try again.
errors.mfa_expired: Sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.reverification_required: Enter a fresh authenticator code first.
errors.status_unchanged: The account already has that status.
errors.network: No connection. Check the network and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.email_in_use: An admin with this email already exists.
errors.self_change_refused: You cannot change your own admin account here.
errors.last_super_admin: This is the last active super admin. Make another super admin first.
errors.password_change_required: This password is temporary. Choose a new password to continue.
errors.password_reused: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.application_not_in_review: This application is not in review any more. Reload the list.
errors.booking_transition_refused: This booking cannot be changed in its current status.
errors.refund_exceeds_paid: The refund is more than what is left to refund.
errors.provider_busy: That provider is busy at this time.
errors.listing_not_eligible: That listing cannot take this booking.
errors.plan_invalid: Those plan details do not fit together. Check the kind, item and period.
errors.plan_item_required: Choose the catalogue item or service the plan covers.
errors.template_placeholders: The wording must keep exactly the same placeholders as the default.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Patients and providers. Names and numbers are masked; opening a user is recorded in the audit log.
users.search: Search by mobile number or name
users.caption: Users, newest first
users.name: Name
users.suspended: Account suspended and signed out of every device.

reverify.title: Confirm with your authenticator
reverify.intro: Sensitive actions need a fresh code.

admins.title: Admins
admins.intro: Admin accounts and sub-roles. Every change needs a fresh authenticator code and signs that admin out of every device. You cannot change your own account here.
admins.caption: Admin accounts
admins.temporaryShown: Temporary password, shown only now. Pass it on securely; it works for 24 hours and must be changed at first sign-in:
admins.roleChanged: Sub-role changed. That admin was signed out.
admins.passwordReset: Password reset. That admin was signed out.
admins.mfaReset: Authenticator reset. That admin sets it up again at the next sign-in.

password.title: My password
password.rules: At least 12 characters. A long phrase is best.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
password.temporaryIntro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password; it replaces the temporary one.

verification.title: Provider verification
verification.intro: Applications waiting for review, oldest first. Opening one starts its review and is recorded.
verification.name: Name
verification.decided: Decision saved. The provider has been told by SMS.

catalogue.title: Service catalogue
catalogue.intro: Items patients can book, in the four MVP services. A paused item disappears from search at once.
catalogue.caption: Catalogue items
catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.pinsIntro: Providers can only serve, and patients only search in, these PIN codes.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: Every booking, newest first. Names are masked; addresses and notes are never shown here.
bookings.caption: Bookings

finance.title: Finance
finance.intro: Money in and out. Payouts settle each provider's available earnings once a week.

tickets.title: Complaints and safety
tickets.intro: Safety concerns (P0) come first. Private text opens only with break-glass: a reason, 30 minutes, and the patient sees it.
tickets.caption: Tickets

reviews.title: Reported reviews
reviews.intro: Hide a review only with a reason; it stays recorded.
reviews.caption: Reported reviews

labs.title: Labs
labs.intro: Approve labs and their collectors in Verification. Here: orders, turnaround against the promised time, and corrections.
labs.caption: Labs
labs.name: Lab

vault.title: Medical record vault
vault.intro: Counts only: no record content is ever shown here (MV-11). Content needs break-glass on a ticket.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Packages and subscriptions (PK-01, PK-02). Provider plans wait here for approval; retired plans stay valid for people who bought them.
plans.caption: Plans
plans.name: Name

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.intro: Flagged referrals wait here (RR-06): release the reward or reject it. Cancel a coupon that was issued by mistake.
referrals.caption: Referrals

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Operations policy (AD-08). Changes apply at once without a deploy, need a fresh code and are audited.
settings.caption: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only a super admin can change settings.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Security console (AD-17): break-glass grants, alerts for failed authorisation and unusual reads, the admin access review, strike reviews, flagged referrals and infected uploads.

content.title: Content
content.intro: Notification wording and the static pages per language (AD-09). Changes apply at once, need a fresh code and are audited. A real SMS provider sends only registered templates: register edited SMS wording with the provider first.
content.readOnly: Only a super admin can change content.
